🧪 Plus Two Chemistry Christmas Exam 2026 – Chapter-Wise Weightage | Important Chapters | Marks Distribution | Kerala HSS Second Terminal Exam

Attention Kerala Plus Two Chemistry students! Are you preparing for the Christmas Exam 2026? Want to know which chapters deserve more attention, how to prioritize important topics, and how to prepare effectively for your Chemistry examination? 💯

In this RK Learning session, we discuss Plus Two Chemistry Christmas Exam 2026 Chapter-Wise Weightage, important chapters, expected question patterns, and smart revision strategies for Kerala Higher Secondary Second Year students.

Understanding chapter-wise marks distribution and practising important questions can help you organize your preparation and manage your revision time effectively.

🎯 Why Watch This Video?

Understanding chapter-wise weightage helps students identify important areas and allocate revision time effectively.

The Kerala Plus Two Chemistry syllabus includes Physical, Inorganic, and Organic Chemistry chapters. Published board-exam weightage guides identify Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics, Coordination Compounds, and Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids as significant chapters. However, Christmas Exam weightage may differ from the final board examination, depending on the portions covered and the examination paper.

What Were These Two Figures Trying to Show Through This Ancient Symbol?

Two ancient Egyptian figures stand facing each other beside a fascinating symbol carved into a stone wall. The mysterious structure between them features unusual shapes, rectangular sections, and a series of small horizontal markings that make it look unlike an ordinary ancient design. Its purpose and meaning remain open to interpretation. Was it a sacred symbol, a representation of an ancient ritual, or something that carried a deeper message? 

Every detail invites curiosity about the beliefs, knowledge, and artistic traditions of ancient Egypt. 

What do you think these two figures were trying to communicate through this mysterious symbol?
.
.
.
 #EgyptianHistory #history #carving #mystery
